nodes.label: add-module Skill
nodes.rationale: Scaffolds a whole module given <ModuleName> <SchemaName>, including solution-file entries and host registration. A much bigger and more error-prone scaffold than a feature slice; deliberately does NOT add a first aggregate — that is a separate /add-feature step once the module shell builds.

nodes.label: Six-Project Module Layout
nodes.rationale: Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Infrastructure.Data, Presentation.WebApi, and the no-suffix composition root are plain Microsoft.NET.Sdk libraries needing no PropertyGroup because the root Directory.Build.props supplies everything. The optional seventh, Presentation.Blazor, is a Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Razor RCL carrying BlazorAssemblyReference and Navigation classes and needing two import files.

nodes.label: Module DbContext and Schema Wiring
nodes.rationale: An internal sealed <Module>DbContext deriving SerginDbContext and implementing both I<Module>DbContext and I<Module>UnitOfWork, with a const Schema, HasDefaultSchema, and ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly, plus a design-time factory so dotnet ef runs without the host project. No entity configuration or migration until the first feature slice adds a table.

nodes.label: InternalsVisibleTo in Three Projects
nodes.rationale: DbContext, repositories, and endpoints are all internal and instantiated only from the composition root, so Infrastructure, Infrastructure.Data, and Presentation.WebApi each need an AssemblyInfo granting InternalsVisibleTo to the composition root. The Blazor RCL needs none — its types are public because the host reflects over them to route.

nodes.label: Empty Domain Namespace Caveat
nodes.rationale: A C# namespace only exists once some type declares it, and the skill deliberately creates the Domain project with zero classes — so the global using for the module's own Domain namespace must be added by the first /add-feature run, not now, or the Application project will not compile.
